entities.summary: Irvin Alexander Kiffin Jr. is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Virginia Union Panthers and Oklahoma Baptist Bison. Kiffin played one season for the San Antonio Spurs in the National Basketball Association (NBA). He also played in Italy and France.
